title: Tank recovery in Bourguébus
caption: A Sherman recovery tank towing a crippled Sherman through the ruined town. Bourguébus, five miles south of Caen on the road to Falaise, was cleared by British infantry and tanks.
note: No 5 Army Film & Photographic Unit. IWM gives no exact date; Bourguébus was taken in the third week of July 1944

title: Going ashore at Bernières
caption: Canadian infantry wait to board landing craft from the troopship HMCS Prince David, off Bernières-sur-Mer on D-Day.
note: Photographer Donovan J. Thorndick. Taken offshore; placed at Bernières

title: Panther knocked out at Bretteville
caption: Regina Rifles anti-tank gunners who stopped a German Panther tank about thirty yards from their battalion headquarters at Bretteville-l'Orgueilleuse.

title: 1st Hussars landing at Courseulles
caption: Tanks of the 1st Hussars and men of the 7th Infantry Brigade come ashore on a crowded beach at Courseulles-sur-Mer.
note: 1st Hussars (6th Armoured Regiment), 2nd Canadian Armoured Brigade

title: Machine-gunners near Carpiquet
caption: Machine-gunners of the Cameron Highlanders of Ottawa firing in support of the attack on Carpiquet.
note: Photographer Lt. Donald I. Grant. 'Near Carpiquet'

title: Rocket strike on Carpiquet airfield
caption: An RAF Typhoon's rocket heads for buildings at Carpiquet airfield on the day the 3rd Canadian Division attacked it.

title: Coming home to Buron
caption: A French family returns to Buron, north-west of Caen, after the village was wrecked in the fighting.

title: Under fire near Fleury-sur-Orne
caption: Canadian soldiers take cover under fire near Fleury-sur-Orne in the early hours of the Verrières Ridge attack.
note: Commons file is titled Verrières; the archive caption names Fleury-sur-Orne

title: Tanks forming up for Falaise
caption: Canadian tanks move into position between Hubert-Folie and Tilly-la-Campagne for the attack toward Falaise.

title: Advancing on Bretteville-le-Rabet
caption: Vehicles of the 3rd Canadian Division move toward Bretteville-le-Rabet on the road to Falaise.
